description: Fixed multi-domain relevance fixtures. Hand-authored labels; no model judging and no real user data. The diagnostic split was initially held out, measured at precision 0.70, then inspected and used to revise rules; it is no longer blind evaluation. The broad database-query label was corrected to include the relevant SQLite document. This is a lexical regression corpus, not production efficacy evidence.
